description: The end control turns 200 about X, which the swing-twist split reads as -160. With the secondary twist at 200 the branch picker returns 200 + wrap(-160 - 200) = 200 + wrap(-360) = 200, so the ramp is 0 to 200 along the ribbon: 100 at u = 0.5, 150 at u = 0.75 and 200 at the end (the same rotation as -160).
